A mark is a labelled moment in the log, and tweaks you apply or undo are marked automatically. BooxUltimatum compares the quiet-asleep draw before and after each mark, and says so plainly when the difference is within a normal day-to-day change.
Not enough data yet: it needs about 12 hours asleep on each side.
